Hi Oliver — thanks for sending this over and flagging. We want to get this cleared quickly. A couple of clarifying items so our AP team can proceed: 

1) Legal status: Please confirm whether the billing entity on the invoice is HelioMed Systems Ltd (UK-incorporated) or HelioMed Holdings Inc (US parent). If the invoice is from the UK entity, we need a signed W-8BEN-E from the UK operating company. If it’s from a US legal entity, we need a W-9.

2) VAT: Please provide the UK VAT registration number for the invoicing entity and confirm whether you expect Redwood to apply reverse-charge treatment. If HelioMed is VAT-registered in the UK and the supply is B2B cross-border services, reverse charge may be appropriate but we need the VAT ID on file.

3) Bank details and currency: Your invoice is in GBP. If you prefer a GBP local wire, please include beneficiary name, account number/IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, and the intermediary bank if applicable.

4) Signed form: If you can attach a completed, signed W-8BEN-E (PDF) for the invoicing legal entity, that will let us mark the vendor as non-US for 1099 purposes.

Next steps on our side: Vivek (cc’d) will confirm whether Redwood needs an EIN from the US parent for any reporting. Laura will open a vendor onboarding ticket and send you the vendor portal link where you can upload documents securely.

If it helps, you can upload docs here: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboarding/helio-med-7421

If you can send the signed W-8 and VAT sheet today we should be able to process the payment within 10 business days once the vendor record is validated.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Thank you — reviewing attachments now. Internal direction: 

- W-8BEN-E present and signed by HelioMed Systems Ltd — treat vendor as non-US for 1099. No 1099 should be issued for this invoice if the W-8 covers the legal entity on the invoice.

- VAT: HelioMed provided GB999888777. For services rendered to Redwood (US-headquartered with EU operations), reverse charge may apply for EU VAT rules. Because this is a UK supplier after Brexit, we need to confirm with TaxOps whether UK-to-UK vs UK-to-US treatment changes anything; I’ve looped in TaxOps (internal ticket BILL-1823) — Laura please add the VAT details into the vendor record and flag for TaxOps review.

- Bank: proceed with GBP local wire once vendor record and banking details are verified in the portal. Payment target: within 10 business days from vendor validation.

Action items: 
1) Laura — create vendor record, upload W-8 and VAT spreadsheet, validate beneficiary name matches W-8 legal name. If there’s any mismatch in legal name vs invoice, request an official letter of authority from HelioMed.
2) Neha — confirm whether Redwood needs the US parent's EIN on file for contract traceability; if so, request that from Oliver.
3) Laura — tag BILL-1823 to TaxOps and change vendor tax classification to "Foreign corporation — W-8 on file" once confirmed.

If TaxOps flags anything unusual we’ll pause payment; otherwise proceed. Thanks.

Vivek
